blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro will remain at the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) amid a recent leadership change in this office. This comes as PCO Acting Secretary Lino Cayetano considers her combative approach a “treasure” in communicating Malacañang’s message to the public. In a media interview on Friday, Cayetano confirmed that appointees under the PCO’s previous leadership have already tendered their courtesy resignations. Political and non-permanent appointees at the PCO are routinely directed to submit courtesy resignations during a leadership change.
